note: Play the story in order, clear the stranger strands before the finale wherever a trophy needs a partner or a character, then finish the counted sets in free roam. The 100% completion gold is the last gate before the platinum.

stages.advice: Play the story straight through. The chapter trophies and the named-mission trophies pop as you go, and the final-mission gold closes the stage. Do not rush past the named missions: six of them are flagged missable because each one belongs to a single mission.
stages.name: Story first

stages.advice: Finish Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret before the story moves on: each of their finals is one mission that closes that strand. Eight finished strands earn the silver. Most of the missables live in this stage, so clear it before the finale.
stages.goal: Every character's final mission, plus 8 stranger strands
stages.name: Strangers and side strands

stages.advice: Work the counted activities: 250 stunts, 42 gold shooting-range challenges, 20 different race wins, 14 drone-race locations, 50 challenges, all 9 activity types once, and the 18 meditation spots. The shooting-range golds are the hardest skill check on the list, so leave them until your aim and weapons are upgraded.
stages.goal: Races, ranges, stunts and one-off feats
stages.name: Activities and skills

stages.advice: Sweep the map: 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas of Leonida, 8 garages bought and 10 vehicles registered to Scooter Bros. None of these is missable, so this stage is pure free-roam grinding after the story.
stages.goal: Cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, areas and garages
stages.name: Collectibles and exploration

stages.advice: Do the partner trophies while the story still puts you together, then rob the vaults, trucks and gang operations, launder $250,000 of marked bills, spend $100,000 in shops, and catch the one-off story beats. Finish with 100% completion, and the platinum pops.
stages.goal: Partner feats, robberies, money and the story beats
stages.name: Money, mayhem and cleanup

title: Road to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
